targets.claim: Automotive technicians can be paid in various ways depending on factors such as where they work, whether they are paid commission, how much they earn, and the state in which they work.
Some automotive technicians may be entitled to overtime under certain conditions.
Automotive technicians can be paid based on different combinations of hourly and commission rates, which can vary depending on their specialization.
The amount automotive technicians earn can vary depending on geographical location.
Automotive technicians in Alaska have the highest average pay of about $23.70 per hour or $49,400 per year.
Automotive technicians that work in aerospace products and parts manufacturing can earn about $32 per hour or $66,300 per year on average.
